tools.name: nomupay_create_payment
tools.description: Creates a new payment via the Nomupay Ecommerce API (POST /v1/payments). Supported payment types: afterpay, alipay, alipay_hk, alipay_plus, atome, au_kantan_kessai, bancontact, bizum, blik, boost, cebuana, dragonpay, duitnow, duitnow_qr, eps, fpx, gcash, grabpay, ideal, konbini, mae, maestro, mastercard, mb_way, multibanco, paymaya, paypal, paypay, paysafecard, payu, przelewy24, satispay, sepa, seven_eleven, shopeepay, softbank_matomete_shiharai, swish, touch_n_go, troy, trustly, twint, upi, upop_securepay, visa, wechat_pay, wero. Natural-language aliases are supported (e.g. "upop" or "union pay" for upop_securepay, "alipay hk" for alipay_hk). Returns the payment status (succeeded | pending | declined | rejected | failed | aborted) and the payment ID. Card payments (visa, mastercard, maestro, troy) do NOT require returnUrl and are typically synchronous (succeeded/declined immediately); returnUrl is not part of their input schema. APMs with returnUrl are asynchronous: the response status is "pending" and includes a "nextStep" block plus a "trackingUrl" that can be polled with nomupay_get_tracking. When nextStep.redirect.method is "post", use the full API response and any redirect params to complete the flow. IMPORTANT: for these APM/returnUrl flows, always show the full JSON response to the user verbatim (do not summarize it away) — in sandbox it is needed as input to the Nomupay Payments Redirect Utility (https://docs.nomupay.com/files/online-payments/nomupay_payments_redirect_utility.html) to complete the payment. Asynchronous outcomes are also delivered via webhooks.

merchantReference.description: Merchant-assigned identifier for the transaction (max 100 chars). Uniqueness is not mandatory.

value.description: Decimal amount, e.g. 10.50. Use "." as decimal separator.

paymentType.description: Payment method type (canonical or alias). Canonical types: afterpay, alipay, alipay_hk, alipay_plus, atome, au_kantan_kessai, bancontact, bizum, blik, boost, cebuana, dragonpay, duitnow, duitnow_qr, eps, fpx, gcash, grabpay, ideal, konbini, mae, maestro, mastercard, mb_way, multibanco, paymaya, paypal, paypay, paysafecard, payu, przelewy24, satispay, sepa, seven_eleven, shopeepay, softbank_matomete_shiharai, swish, touch_n_go, troy, trustly, twint, upi, upop_securepay, visa, wechat_pay, wero. Aliases: "upop"/"union pay" (upop_securepay), "alipay hk" (alipay_hk).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique request identifier (8–50 chars). Use the same key to safely retry a request without duplicating the payment.

capture.description: Whether the payment is captured automatically (auto) or held for later manual capture (manual).

cardNumber.description: Card number (PAN). Required unless accountTokenId is used.

cardExpiryMonth.description: Card expiry month (1–12). Required when cardNumber is provided.

cardExpiryYear.description: Card expiry year (YYYY). Required when cardNumber is provided.

cardCvv.description: Card verification value (3 digits). Optional but recommended.

cardHolderName.description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card. Optional.

accountTokenId.description: Nomupay token ID. Alternative to raw cardNumber.

returnUrl.description: URL to redirect the consumer after the payment. Required.

description.description: Consumer-facing description shown on the payment page (max 25 chars). Optional.

expirationTime.description: ISO 8601 deadline for the customer to complete the payment. Defaults to 120 minutes.

upopLocale.description: Locale of the UnionPay SecurePay page. Optional.

consumerName.description: Full name of the consumer. Optional.

consumerPhoneNumber.description: Mobile phone number of the consumer. Optional for konbini.

consumerEmail.description: Email address of the consumer. Required.

billingCountry.description: Billing address country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required for certain countries.

consumerReference.description: Unique consumer identifier in the merchant system (max 50 chars). Required.

orderItems.description: List of order items. Each item must include name, quantity, and an amount object { value, currency }. Some methods also require id.

id.description: Unique item identifier. Required for au_kantan_kessai, konbini, paypay, softbank_matomete_shiharai.

name.description: Name of the order item. Required.

amount.description: Total amount for this line (value + currency). Used by au_kantan_kessai, konbini, paypay, softbank_matomete_shiharai.

unitAmount.description: Amount per unit (value + currency). Used by afterpay, paypal.

bankCode.description: Bank code for DuitNow payment (e.g. "maybank", "cimb_bank", "public_bank"). Required.

phoneNumber.description: Swedish mobile phone number (must start with +46). Required only when flowType is "self_phone_number_collection". Not allowed for "redirection".

ipAddress.description: IP address of consumer. Required only when flowType is "deep_link". Not allowed for "qr_link".

bankAccountNumber.description: IBAN or bank account number (14–34 chars). Required.

mandateReference.description: Mandate reference (max 35 chars). Required for self_mandate_collection flowType.

mandateSignatureDate.description: Mandate signature date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for self_mandate_collection flowType.

mandateUrl.description: URL where the mandate can be found. Optional.

tools.name: nomupay_create_credit
tools.description: Creates a standalone credit via the Nomupay Ecommerce API (POST /v1/credits). Credits support visa and mastercard only and return succeeded, declined, rejected, or failed. Use nomupay_get_credit_by_idempotency_key for timeout recovery.

merchantReference.description: Merchant-assigned identifier for the credit (max 100 chars). Uniqueness is not mandatory.

value.description: Decimal amount, e.g. 10.50. Use "." as decimal separator.

paymentType.description: Card scheme for the credit: visa or mastercard.

cardNumber.description: Card number (PAN). Required unless accountTokenId is used.

cardExpiryMonth.description: Card expiry month (1-12). Required when cardNumber is provided.

cardExpiryYear.description: Card expiry year (YYYY). Required when cardNumber is provided.

cardHolderName.description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card. Optional.

accountTokenId.description: Nomupay token ID. Alternative to raw cardNumber.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique request identifier (8–50 chars). Use the same key to safely retry a request without duplicating the payment.

tools.name: nomupay_create_token
tools.description: Creates a card token via the Nomupay Ecommerce API (POST /v1/tokens). Returns an existing active token (200) or a newly created token (201).

tools.name: nomupay_refund_payment
tools.description: Refunds a specific amount from a captured Nomupay payment (POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refunds). Returns the refund status (succeeded | pending | declined | rejected | failed) and refund ID. Asynchronous outcomes are delivered via webhooks.

paymentId.description: The Nomupay payment ID to refund. This is the "id" field returned by nomupay_create_payment.

merchantReference.description: Merchant-assigned identifier for this refund operation (max 100 chars).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must match the original payment currency.

amount.description: Amount to refund. Must not exceed the captured amount.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique request identifier (8–50 chars). Use the same key to safely retry a refund request without duplicating it.

tools.name: nomupay_increment_payment
tools.description: Increments the authorized amount of an authorized payment (POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/increments). Returns the increment status (succeeded | declined | rejected | failed) and increment ID. Asynchronous outcomes are delivered via webhooks.

paymentId.description: The Nomupay payment ID to increment. This is the "id" field returned by nomupay_create_payment.

merchantReference.description: Merchant-assigned identifier for this increment operation (max 100 chars).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must match the original payment currency.

amount.description: Amount to increment the authorized total by.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique request identifier (8–50 chars) for safe retries.

tools.name: nomupay_capture_payment
tools.description: Captures a specific amount from an authorized payment (POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/captures). Returns the capture status (succeeded | pending | declined | rejected | failed) and capture ID. When the status is "pending", the response includes a "trackingUrl" that can be polled with nomupay_get_tracking to retrieve the final outcome. Asynchronous outcomes are also delivered via webhooks.

paymentId.description: The Nomupay payment ID to capture. This is the "id" field returned by nomupay_create_payment.

merchantReference.description: Merchant-assigned identifier for this capture operation (max 100 chars).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must match the original payment currency.

amount.description: Amount to capture. Must not exceed the authorized amount.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique request identifier (8–50 chars) for safe retries.

tools.name: nomupay_cancel_payment
tools.description: Cancels a specific amount from an authorized payment that has not yet been captured (POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/cancels). Returns the cancel status (succeeded | pending | declined | rejected | failed) and cancel ID. When the status is "pending", the response includes a "trackingUrl" that can be polled with nomupay_get_tracking to retrieve the final outcome. Asynchronous outcomes are also delivered via webhooks.

paymentId.description: The Nomupay payment ID to cancel. This is the "id" field returned by nomupay_create_payment.

merchantReference.description: Merchant-assigned identifier for this cancel operation (max 100 chars).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must match the original payment currency.

amount.description: Amount to cancel from the authorized total.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique request identifier (8–50 chars) for safe retries.

tools.name: nomupay_get_payments
tools.description: Retrieves all payments for a date range (GET /v1/payments). Supports filtering by statuses, payment methods, stores, and free-text search. Returns a paginated list with a cursor for subsequent pages.

fromTime.description: Start of the date range (inclusive), ISO 8601 UTC. E.g. "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z".

toTime.description: End of the date range (inclusive), ISO 8601 UTC. Must be >= fromTime and <= now.

targetTime.description: Which date field to filter on. Defaults to "createTime".

q.description: Free-text search across IDs, references, account numbers, approval codes, etc.

first.description: Number of results to retrieve (1–100). Defaults to 10.

after.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call to get the next page.

tools.name: nomupay_get_payment_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a single payment and its related transactions (GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}).

tools.name: nomupay_get_payment_by_idempotency_key
tools.description: Retrieves a payment result by idempotency key — useful for timeout recovery (GET /v1/requests/payments). Use this when a create-payment request timed out and you need the result without creating a duplicate.

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key used in the original payment request (8–50 chars).

tools.name: nomupay_get_increment_by_idempotency_key
tools.description: Retrieves a increment result by idempotency key — useful for timeout recovery (GET /v1/requests/increments).

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key used in the original increment request (8–50 chars).

tools.name: nomupay_get_capture_by_idempotency_key
tools.description: Retrieves a capture result by idempotency key — useful for timeout recovery (GET /v1/requests/captures).

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key used in the original capture request (8–50 chars).

tools.name: nomupay_get_cancel_by_idempotency_key
tools.description: Retrieves a cancel result by idempotency key — useful for timeout recovery (GET /v1/requests/cancels).

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key used in the original cancel request (8–50 chars).

tools.name: nomupay_get_refund_by_idempotency_key
tools.description: Retrieves a refund result by idempotency key — useful for timeout recovery (GET /v1/requests/refunds).

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key used in the original refund request (8–50 chars).

tools.name: nomupay_get_credit_by_idempotency_key
tools.description: Retrieves a credit result by idempotency key — useful for timeout recovery (GET /v1/requests/credits).

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key used in the original credit request (8–50 chars).

tools.name: nomupay_get_transactions
tools.description: Retrieves all transactions (payments, captures, refunds, etc.) for a date range (GET /v1/transactions). Returns a paginated list with funding, fees, and tax details per transaction.

fromTime.description: Start of the date range (inclusive), ISO 8601 UTC.

toTime.description: End of the date range (inclusive), ISO 8601 UTC.

targetTime.description: Which date field to filter on. Defaults to "createTime".

q.description: Free-text search across IDs, references, account numbers, approval codes, etc.

first.description: Number of results to retrieve (1–100). Defaults to 10.

after.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call to get the next page.

tools.name: nomupay_get_transaction_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a single transaction including fees, taxes, and funding (GET /v1/transactions/{transactionId}).

tools.name: nomupay_get_token_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a payment token (GET /v1/tokens/{tokenId}).

tools.name: nomupay_get_tracking
tools.description: Polls the tracking URL for an async operation result (GET /v1/tracks/{operationType}/{trackId}). Use this when a payment, capture, cancel, or refund returned a "pending" status with a trackingUrl. The trackingUrl from the API response is in the form "/v1/tracks/{operationType}/{trackId}".

operationType.description: The type of operation to track.

trackId.description: The track ID from the trackingUrl in the pending operation response.
